in_marathi.name: Ajaj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ajaj is a Sanskrit and Hindu name meaning 'warrior' or 'conqueror'. It is a powerful name for a boy and is often given to children who are expected to grow up to be strong and brave.
